# PingID API Reference

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Pingid Api

- [Authentication using browser redirect (PPM request)](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiPpmrequest.md): Authentication using browser redirect (PPM request)
- [Example: PingID FIDO biometrics](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiExampleFIDObiometrics.md): Example of FIDO biometrics pairing and authentication
- [Example: PingID FIDO passwordless Authentication](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiExamplePasswordless.md): Example of PingID FIDO passwordless authentication
- [Example: PingID FIDO security key](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiExampleFIDOsecurityKey.md): Example of FIDO security key pairing and authentication
- [Example: PingID User Registration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiExampleUserRegistration.md): Example of registering a new PingID user and pairing first online device
- [PingID API Error Codes](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiErrorCodes.md): PingID API return status values and descriptions
- [PingID API Overview](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiOverview.md): Overview of the PingID API for developers
- [PingID Application Policy Management API for PingFederate](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiPFapplicationPolicy.md): PingID Application Policy Management API for PingFederate
- [PingID Authentication API](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiAuthentication.md): PingID online and offline authentication operations
- [PingID User Management API](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiUserManagement.md): PingID user and device management operations
- [Related resources](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pid_c_PingIDapiRelatedResources.md): Additional resources for developers using PingID API
- [Web Authentication Policy API](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingid-api/pingid_policy_api.md): Creating authentication policies with the Web Authentication Policy API
